name: MD Environment Reasoning QA 8
description: This is a task to reason about correct actions in solving an agent benchmark problem related to using molecular dynamics for calculating diffusion coefficient.

examples.input:
This is a task from an agent benchmark. An MD simulation of silicon is performed in two stages: (1) heating under NPT from 300 K to 2500 K to melt the solid, and (2) a production run at 2500 K to compute the self-diffusion coefficient from the mean squared displacement (MSD). The goal is to ensure that the MSD is computed with the correct time origin corresponding to the start of the production (liquid) run.

Below are a few scenarios that may contain the agent's correct/incorrect script snippets.

Scenario A:
# End of heating stage
unfix heat

# Start production stage
reset_timestep 0
compute msd_all all msd
variable msd equal c_msd_all[4]
run 500000

Scenario B:
# End of heating stage
unfix heat

# Start production stage (no timestep reset)
compute msd_all all msd
variable msd equal c_msd_all[4]
run 500000

Scenario C:
# Compute MSD during heating stage
compute msd_all all msd
variable msd equal c_msd_all[4]
fix heat all npt temp 300 2500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 1000000

Which scenario corresponds to a valid reasoning?
